questions.cardText:
[Metereology] What is the primary difference between hurricanes, typhoons, and cyclones?
A. Their intensity
B. The direction they spin
C. Their location
Answer: C. Hurricanes, typhoons, and cyclones are all the same type of storm, but named differently based on where they occur. Hurricanes form in the Atlantic and Northeast Pacific, typhoons in the Northwest Pacific, and cyclones in the South Pacific and Indian Ocean.
questions.en: Hurricanes, typhoons and cyclones are the same type of storm. What decides which of the three names such a storm gets?
questions.de: Hurrikane, Taifune und Zyklone sind dieselbe Art von Sturm. Wonach richtet sich, welchen der drei Namen ein solcher Sturm trägt?
questions.answerDe: Nach dem Meeresgebiet, in dem er auftritt

timeline.labelEn: Henry Piddington publishes his papers on tropical storms in Calcutta and coins the word 'cyclone'
timeline.labelDe: Henry Piddington veröffentlicht in Kalkutta seine Arbeiten über tropische Stürme und prägt das Wort „Zyklon“

questions.notes: The card's discipline is printed misspelled ('Metereology'); kept verbatim. Timeline from the Cyclone article (Piddington coined the word; papers 1836–1855).

questions.cardText:
[Art History] Which of the following are characteristics of Gothic architecture?
A. Pointed arches and ribbed vaults
B. Minimalist structures
C. Large, open spaces
Answer: A.
questions.en: Which kind of arches and which kind of vaults are characteristic of Gothic architecture?
questions.de: Welche Art von Bögen und welche Art von Gewölben sind typisch für die gotische Architektur?

timeline.labelEn: Rebuilding of the choir of the Abbey of Saint-Denis near Paris, considered the first Gothic building
timeline.labelDe: Neubau des Chors der Abtei Saint-Denis bei Paris, die als erstes gotisches Bauwerk gilt
